import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: Contains 2017 data (suffix _17 columns)
df_17 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Load Source 1: Contains 2015 data (suffix _15 columns) + Region
df_15 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Rename Source 1 columns to match target schema suffix _15
df_15_renamed = df_15.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# Select only the columns needed from df_15_renamed
df_15_selected = df_15_renamed[[
    'Country', 'Region', 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15'
]]

# For df_17, columns already mostly match target suffix _17, except Country and no Region
# We need to add Region from df_15 by joining on Country

# Rename df_17 columns to ensure consistent naming (strip spaces if any)
df_17.columns = df_17.columns.str.strip()

# Join df_17 with df_15_selected to get Region and ensure Country is consistent
# Use 'Country' as join key
df_merged = pd.merge(
    df_15_selected[['Country', 'Region']],
    df_17,
    on='Country',
    how='inner',
    validate='one_to_one'
)

# Now df_merged has Region and all _17 columns plus Country

# Rename df_17 columns to target schema names (add _17 suffix if not present)
# The source columns in df_17 are already named with _17 suffix except Country
# Just ensure columns are exactly as target schema expects

# Target schema columns for 17 suffix:
expected_17_cols = [
    'Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

# Check if all expected columns exist in df_merged
missing_cols = set(expected_17_cols) - set(df_merged.columns)
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in 2017 data after merge: {missing_cols}")

# Now join df_merged with df_15_selected on Country to bring in 2015 columns (except Region which we already have)
# We already have Region from df_15_selected in df_merged, so just join on Country to get 2015 columns except Region

# Drop Region from df_15_selected to avoid duplication
df_15_no_region = df_15_selected.drop(columns=['Region'])

# Merge on Country to get 2015 columns
final_df = pd.merge(
    df_merged,
    df_15_no_region,
    on='Country',
    how='inner',
    validate='one_to_one'
)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

final_df = final_df[target_columns]

# Save the final dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/target_multisource_cot.csv"
final_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {output_path}")
